$description: Atelier design tokens (DTCG), rebranded for TASAMA (tasama.com.sa). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit here only; never hand-edit src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.tsx. Palette read from the computed styles of tasama.com.sa: #10069F wordmark ultramarine, #07105F hero navy, #342BAD panel violet, #B59E5F bilingual-subline gold, #ADDC91 portrait nimbus green. REBRANDING CONTRACT: a client rebrand changes ONLY color.light, color.dark, the brand block, typography.fontFamily and the asset files in public/brand/. Everything else stays identical across every app. See docs/REBRANDING.md.

primary.$description: Tasama ultramarine — the wordmark ink, used verbatim; white on it clears AAA.

secondary.$description: The violet-blue Tasama uses for filled panels on tasama.com.sa.

accent.$description: Tasama gold #B59E5F deepened to clear 4.5:1 on the light background; hue preserved (~43°), so it stays the brand's second colour rather than a different one.

chart1.$description: Categorical series colour, slot 1 of a fixed five. Assigned in this order, never cycled. The whole set is validated for OKLCH lightness band, chroma floor, colour-vision-deficient adjacent separation, normal-vision separation and contrast against the chart surface — blue and violet are deliberately NOT adjacent because that is the one pair CVD cannot separate. Brand ultramarine #10069F is too dark to sit in the band, so slot 1 is its in-band relative; the brand colour itself stays on fills and buttons.

primary.$description: Tasama ultramarine lifted for the dark theme — #10069F is far too dark to carry text or fills on a navy ground.

accent.$description: Tasama gold lifted for the dark theme — the logo's own blue-and-gold pairing, inverted.

sans.$description: Body, UI labels, buttons, stats, tables. Inter: tabular numerals hold dense financial tables. Weights 400, 600, 800.

serif.$description: Atelier's --font-serif is the heading/display face. Comfortaa is Cognirise's own display face (400/700), kept across every client app per Mounir's instruction; the client supplies colours, logo and backdrops only.

mono.$description: Eyebrows, section labels, references, telemetry chips.

wordmark.$description: The product wordmark in the title bar, in Cognirise's display face.

brand.$description: The TASAMA brand layer: signature gradient, status hues, backdrop stops, wallpaper art and the hero dark island.

gradient.$description: Four stops of the signature accent gradient (--brand-grad), running ultramarine → violet → lifted ultramarine → gold: the wordmark's own blue-to-gold pairing, in the order the logo reads. stop3 matches color.dark.primary.

highlight.$description: TASAMA's highlight green — the colour on their own call-to-action pills. Used for interactive affordances and for the measures that are about the CLIENT rather than about performance. Never used on a status surface: RAG green means something else, and two greens on one screen is how a reader starts guessing.

wash.$description: The brand colour verbatim. A fill, not a text colour — 1.6:1 on white.

light.$description: Deepened to clear 4.5:1 on both white and the light background; hue preserved at 93°.

dark.$description: On the dark background the brand colour is legible as drawn — 12.4:1 — so it is used exactly as TASAMA draws it.

status.$description: Status is not brand. Green, amber and red stay recognisable even though none of them is a Tasama colour.

backdrop.$description: Three stops of the fixed 160° backdrop gradient, shown while the wallpaper loads and behind its transparent regions.

backdropArtOpacity.$description: Wallpaper is a faint brand detail only: 10% opacity in light mode and 12% in dark mode, keeping headings and financial data easy to read.

hero.$description: The .page-hero dark island, held in BOTH themes. #07105F is Tasama's own hero band colour, lifted straight from the business-landing pages, and its accent is the gold the wordmark already pairs with it.
